index.html.title: EventHook | EventHook
index.html.summary: EventHook A .NET 10 library for global keyboard, mouse, clipboard, application, print, and hotkey events on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Install dotnet add package EventHook Quick start using (var factory = new EventHookFactory()) { var keyboard = factory.GetKeyboardWatcher(); var result = keyboard.Start(); if (result.Success) { keyboard.OnKeyInput += (_, e) => Console.WriteLine(e.KeyData.Keyname); } else { Console.WriteLine(result); } } See the GitHub README for full samples.
